_scenario_name: Praxis Labs — SG parent, India engineer exercises options
_narrative: Praxis Labs Pte Ltd is Singapore-incorporated, 35-person team. Their senior engineer based in Bengaluru, employed by Praxis India Pvt Ltd subsidiary, has 10,000 vested options at $0.10 strike. FMV at exercise is $0.50. She exercises 4,000 options on 30 April 2026. The headline cross-border case.
